purpose: Define one recognizable channel identity across banners, thumbnails, videos and live assets.
creative_positioning: Premium modern listening environments for Jazz, Soul and Lo-Fi audiences who want to relax, study, work or unwind.
visual_medium: Cinematic editorial photography with realistic materials, controlled film grain and modern art direction.
non_negotiable: No anime, illustration, drawing, comic linework or character art.
No generic stock-photo look, generic lo-fi collage or disposable thumbnail aesthetics.
No mixing of Jazz, Soul and Lo-Fi labels in a way that misrepresents the playlist.
No repeated scene concept, composition or hero object across consecutive videos.
Every visual must be linked to its playlist, music mood and approved reference evidence.

composition: one strong visual idea per asset
central safe area for channel title when required
lighting: warm interior light against cool ambient shadows

typography.thumbnail_rule: Use only the exact playlist or video title; never add invented genre claims or technical filler.

asset_rules.channel_cover: Brand-level environment, no playlist-specific title, no characters, no drawings.
asset_rules.video_thumbnail: One unique scene tied to the actual music profile; title and genre must be truthful.
asset_rules.video_visual: Locked camera, localized professional effects, reference-bound scene and audited motion.
asset_rules.live_graphics: Use the channel system without introducing a new visual identity.
